scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --stream --parallel --filter @lore-co/api --filter @lore-co/web run dev'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && vitest run && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
scripts.test:db: pnpm build:packages && RUN_DATABASE_TESTS=1 vitest run tests/database.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:db:compose: pnpm build:packages && docker compose --profile test up -d --wait postgres-test && RUN_DATABASE_TESTS=1 TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/lore_test vitest run tests/database.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:devin:live: pnpm build:packages && sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; tsx scripts/devin-live-acceptance.ts'
scripts.test:github:live: pnpm build:packages && sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; tsx scripts/github-pr-live-acceptance.ts'
scripts.dev:mcp: pnpm build:packages && sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; node packages/mcp/dist/index.js'
scripts.demo: pnpm build:packages && sh -c 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; tsx scripts/demo.ts'
